_note: MODEL_PATH is either a stock Ultralytics model name such as yolo11n.pt, which Ultralytics downloads on first use, or <package>/<path>, whose first segment names an installed ROS package and whose rest is resolved under that package's share directory (cine_sensing_config.constants.resolve_package_relative_path); weights placed in cine_sensing_yolo/models/ are installed there. USER_OBJECT_ID is the class index the detector keeps; 56 is chair in the COCO classes of the stock model. Do not hardcode absolute paths here.
